ja: -特別パッケージ仕様版-
ＭＧＥＸ 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム Ver．Ka ［プレミアム “ユニコーンモード" ボックス］が登場！
通常版と異なる“ユニコーンモード”を主体としたボックスアートでお届け！
• アイテム情報
●　極限の“発光機構”
新規開発の”フレキシブルLEDシート”により、変身、発光、色調変化、可動すべての共立を実現。
・ユニコーンモード、デストロイモードの変身を再現可能。
・赤色の発光から緑色の発光への色調変化を表現可能。
・シールド単独ディスプレイ時も専用ディスプレイスタンドにより発光。
・新設計された変身機構は、直感的かつスムーズな変身を可能に。
・向上した膝可動、肩の引き出しギミックなど、各所の設計を見直し、広い可動域を確保。
●　カトキハジメ氏完全監修
氏の完全監修のもと、全身の設計・デザインを再構築し、新規造形で製作。
●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
カトキハジメ氏デザインのマーキングが水転写式デカールで付属。
●　専用ＭＳ ＣＡＧＥがセット
電飾ユニットの電池ＢＯＸを格納した専用のＭＳ ＣＡＧＥが付属。ディスプレイ用支柱の位置調整、武器の保持が可能。
また、リード線を使用することで、シールドファンネルの発光演出も可能。
●　通常版と異なる“ユニコーンモード”を主体としたボックスアートでお届け。
付属武装 ：　ビーム・マグナム　／　ビーム・サーベル　／　シールド　／　ビーム・ガトリングガン　／　ハイパー・バズーカ
付属物　：　専用ＭＳ ＣＡＧＥ

en: -Special package specification version-
MGEX 1/100 Unicorn Gundam Ver. Ka [Premium “Unicorn Mode” Box] is now available!
Delivered with box art featuring a “unicorn mode” that is different from the regular version!
• Item information
● Extreme “light-emitting mechanism”
The newly developed "flexible LED sheet" realizes transformation, light emission, color change, and movement.
- Unicorn mode and Destroy mode transformations can be reproduced.
・It is possible to express a change in color tone from red light emission to green light emission.
・Even when Seal is displayed alone, it emits light using a dedicated display stand.
- The newly designed transformation mechanism enables intuitive and smooth transformation.
・We have reviewed the design of various parts, such as improved knee movement and shoulder pull-out gimmick, to ensure a wide range of motion.
● Fully supervised by Hajime Katoki
Under his complete supervision, the entire body was redesigned and produced with new modeling.
● Newly designed water transfer decal included!
Marking designed by Hajime Katoki is included as a water transfer decal.
● Dedicated MS CAGE is included
Comes with a dedicated MS CAGE that stores the battery box for the illumination unit. It is possible to adjust the position of the display support and hold weapons.
In addition, by using the lead wire, it is possible to create a luminous effect of the sealed funnel.
● Delivered with box art featuring a “unicorn mode” that is different from the regular version.
Attached weapons: Beam Magnum / Beam Saber / Seal / Beam Gatling Gun / Hyper Bazooka
Accessories: Dedicated MS CAGE
*The product contents of this product are the same as the regular version "MGEX 1/100 Unicorn Gundam Ver. Ka" (in-store sales product 20209ReleaseScheduled).
Only the package design is different.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS, PE, ABS, PP, PA, PI, PMMA
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
- Three AA batteries (sold separately) are required to light the LED unit. *For alkaline batteries only.
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Due to the manufacturing process, air bubbles may appear in the clear parts.
*Product materials may change depending on the production period of the sold product. Thank you for your understanding.
